reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first, APIError and LinkAccountFields types in a single new helper, but does not hook into the shared linkAccountAndSync that every provider already funnels through.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once, but the guard call is pasted into all five provider link functions, each restating the account_id and sync-source literal it passes again to linkAccountAndSync a few lines later.

placement.why: The helper sits in server/accounts/app.ts next to linkAccountAndSync; calling it per provider is defensible because findOrCreateBank runs before the shared function, though a restructure could keep it in one layer.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and focused tests.

maintainability.why: One clear query decides what counts as linked, but a sixth provider must remember to add the guard and keep its sync-source literal in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link paths still go through linkAccountAndSync; the new check is a sibling helper called before it in each provider function

disguised_duplication.where: The five guard calls are plain repeated call sites of one helper, not reshaped copies of logic

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts holds the rule; linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount all call it (rather than linkAccountAndSync calling it once)
